sources.used: React supports a from-scratch route using tools such as Vite; SPA selection is project recommendation, not universal official recommendation.
WebSocket support; example memory connection registry is single-process only.
Heavy background computation is distinct from small request background tasks; chose a separate vision process without prematurely requiring Celery.
Installability requires HTTPS or localhost/loopback conditions; LAN web access does not itself establish installation or offline-order support.
Official row-level locking description supports transaction/concurrency plan; no database executed.

boundary: Technical documentation reviewed for architecture planning only; no packages installed or application implementation run.
